lines.l: From the head of the mountain of love
Tell the head of the mountain
Tell from the blood, tell from the rose, tell from the night
Sad e ha ke nemim ne begoo Begoo az ma gobe ha
Nasdara ha ye banash Sofre ha ye pirya
As far as the heart is concerned, the heart is silent
Tell me from the blood, tell me from the rose, tell me from the night
